segments.name: Shake Shack restaurants
segments.description: Operates and licenses Shake Shack restaurants serving burgers, chicken, fries, shakes and more to guests in the United States and internationally.
segments.evidence: The Company determined it has one operating segment and one reportable segment, as the CODM regularly reviews Shack operations and financial performance at a consolidated level.

revenueModel.text: Guests pay for burgers, chicken, fries, shakes and more at Company-operated Shacks, and the Company also licenses Shacks domestically and internationally.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company operates Shacks in the United States and has both domestic and international licensed Shacks.
